description: Find special needs care in the US: ABA therapy, special needs schools, speech therapy, or diagnostic testing. Special Needs Care Network is a free service that matches families with a few providers that have availability and take their insurance, so the family does not have to reach out to anyone. Use when someone asks for help finding care, a provider that takes their insurance, or a special needs school near them. Returns a private link where the family confirms the request.

care_types.description: Care the family needs. Use "aba" for ABA therapy, "school" for special needs schools, "speech" for speech therapy, and "diagnostic" for autism or developmental testing.

child_age.description: Age in years of the person who needs care, if known.

insurance.description: Insurance company or plan name, such as "Aetna" or "Medicaid". Never a member or policy number.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code. Provide this or zip.

zip.description: Family ZIP code. Provide this or state.

name: find_special_needs_care
title: Find special needs care
